name: Environment: Tropical Rainforests
summary: Funds work that keeps tropical rainforests standing by stopping deforestation, mostly strategic policy work but also local projects run by Indigenous peoples and local communities over large areas. Applications go by email to the foundation.

calls.label: Twice-yearly deadlines
calls.recurring: Deadlines on 1 June and 1 November every year

status.quote: The 2 deadlines for applications to our Tropical Rainforests programme fall on the following dates every year: 1st November 1st June

applicant_types.quote: We prioritise providing funding support to UK-based charities, many of whom work in close partnership with smaller local NGOs based in the countries in which they operate.

access.quote: Please note that all applications must be submitted to applications@waterloofoundation.org.uk.
